name: Changelog
summary: A dark Linear-style changelog system with near-black canvas, compact spacing, Inter Variable typography, Berkeley Mono accents, pill-outline actions, and surface depth created by gray steps and 1px borders.

carbonSurface.role: Elevated cards, inputs, and subtle surface layers

graphiteSurface.role: Nested panels, icon tiles, and code snippets

smokeSurface.role: Hover surfaces, low-contrast button surfaces, and key borders

ironSurface.role: Pressed state and highest dark elevation

ashBorder.role: Primary dividers, table rows, and list separators

ferriteBorder.role: Inner strokes, focus-adjacent borders, and subtle outlines

steelText.role: Tertiary text, low-emphasis icons, and helper copy

fogText.role: Metadata, timestamps, muted body, and nav sub-items

mistText.role: Secondary text, body copy, and descriptions

chalkBorder.role: Rare light dividers and icon accents

snow.role: Primary text, headings, logo, and outlined button border

void.role: Deep recess, absolute dark accent, and shadow tint

typography.monoSubstitute: JetBrains Mono or IBM Plex Mono

elevation.subtleStack: Layer surfaces one gray step at a time instead of using blurred shadows.

components.topNavigation: Sticky black header with bottom hairline, muted nav links, ghost login, and outlined sign-up pill.
components.outlinedPillButton: Transparent 9999px pill with 1px Snow border, Snow text, Inter 14px weight 510, and no fill.
components.ghostTextButton: Borderless muted text button that brightens to Snow on hover.
components.searchInput: Carbon Surface input with 1px Smoke Surface border, 4px radius, muted placeholder, and compact height.
components.sectionTabs: Left-aligned compact tabs with active Snow label, muted inactive labels, and no heavy underline.
components.dateMarker: Tiny muted label with optional 6px dot, used to mark changelog timing.
components.changelogEntryHeading: Inter 24px to 32px, weight 510, Snow, compact tracking, with optional hash anchor on hover.
components.iconGrid: Grid of 64px dark tiles with 8px radius, 1px border, and centered white glyphs.
components.commandReferenceCard: Graphite Surface card with 1px Smoke border, 4px radius, Berkeley Mono content, and compact padding.
components.bodyParagraph: 15px to 16px Inter body copy in Mist Text with constrained line length.

dos: Use Onyx Canvas as the full-page base.
Use Snow for the strongest text and outlined action borders.
Use Inter Variable weight 510 for headings and active controls.
Use weight 590 for emphasis instead of heavy bold.
Layer the near-black surface ladder one step at a time.
Use 1px hairline borders for all structural separation.
Reserve Berkeley Mono for code-adjacent accents only.
Keep spacing compact and based on a 4px rhythm.
donts: Do not introduce chromatic brand fills or gradient CTAs.
Do not use filled buttons for primary actions.
Do not use heavy drop shadows for depth.
Do not use card radii larger than 8px except pill controls.
Do not use 600 or 700 display weights when variable 510 or 590 is available.
Do not use Berkeley Mono for full paragraphs or main headings.
Do not add lifestyle photography or decorative illustrations.
Do not loosen the layout into a spacious marketing page.
